Igor Chernyshov will be out long-term for the #SJSharks. With Wennberg already out week to week, what's next? Read more on Sharks Hockey Digest.

Igor Chernyshov is doubtful to return to tonight's #SJSharks game. SJ was already down Alexander Wennberg before the game. Read more on Sharks Hockey Digest.

Alexander Wennberg will miss the remainder of the #SJSharks road trip. The alternate captain suffered an upper-body injury during Monday's game. Read the update on his status on Sharks Hockey Digest.
sharkshockeydigest.com/san-jose-sha...
Wennberg is now considered week-to-week. Will be reevaluated when the team returns to San Jose.
